events.stem:
Consider the following reactions. In each, look at the product that contains the named element (balanced equations are not needed).
(i) [Ag(CN)₂]⁻, Zn dust, cyanide process  →  product containing Zn
(ii) H₂S₂O₇, H₂O, dilution  →  product containing S
(iii) CoCl₂, NH₄Cl, excess NH₃, air bubbled through, charcoal  →  product containing Co
(iv) Al₄C₃, HCl, acid treatment  →  product containing C
(v) Cu²⁺, excess KCN  →  product containing Cu
(vi) Cr³⁺, excess NaOH  →  product containing Cr
(vii) CuCl₂, Cl⁻ (conc.), excess chloride  →  product containing Cu
(viii) Ag, KCN, O₂, aerated cyanide solution  →  product containing Ag
The number of reactions in which the named element in that product is d²sp³ hybridised is
Give the answer as an integer.

members.working: Identify product containing named element for each reaction and determine hybridization d²sp³ (octahedral low-spin). (i) Zn in cyanide process likely forms Zn(CN)2 or Zn complex; Zn2+ is d10, not d²sp³. (ii) S in H2S2O7 dilution gives H2SO4 etc, S in sulfate (S6+?) sulfate ion is tetrahedral? Not d²sp³. (iii) Co with NH3 excess gives Co(III) complex possibly low-spin Co(NH3)6^3+ which is d²sp³? Co3+ d5 low-spin gives t2g5, uses d²sp³? Actually octahedral low-spin uses d²sp³ (t2g + eg? low-spin uses t2g and d orbitals? Typically d²sp³ for octahedral complexes with strong field leads to low-spin using dxy,dxz,dyz (t2g) and dz2,dx2-y2 (eg) plus s,p? Hybridization d²sp³ includes two d, one s, three p. So Co(III) low-spin could be d²sp³. However reaction includes air bubbled through, may oxidize Co to Co(II) or Co(III) hydroxide. Likely Co(OH)3 precipitate, not d²sp³. (iv) C from Al4C3 + HCl gives CH4, carbon not hybridized. (v) Cu2+ with KCN excess forms [Cu(CN)4]2- maybe square planar? Cu(II) often d9, not d²sp³. (vi) Cr3+ with NaOH gives Cr(OH)3 precipitate, not d²sp³. (vii) CuCl2 with excess Cl- forms [CuCl4]2- tetrahedral or square planar, not d²sp³. (viii) Ag with KCN and O2 gives AgCN or Ag(CN)2-? Silver cyanide AgCN is linear? Not d²sp³. Thus none have d²sp³ hybridized product. Count = 0.

members.working:
Check each product for d²sp³ (inner-orbital octahedral) hybridisation of the named element:
(i) Zn product: [Zn(CN)₄]²⁻ — Zn²⁺ is d¹⁰, tetrahedral sp³ → no.
(ii) S product: H₂SO₄ (from oleum + water) — not a coordination complex; S is not d²sp³ → no.
(iii) Co product: [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ (air oxidation, charcoal gives luteo salt) — Co³⁺ d⁶ low-spin, inner-orbital d²sp³ → yes.
(iv) C product: CH₄ (Al₄C₃ + acid) — C is sp³ → no.
(v) Cu product: [Cu(CN)₄]³⁻ — Cu(I) d¹⁰, sp³/tetrahedral → no.
(vi) Cr product: [Cr(OH)₆]³⁻ — Cr³⁺ d³, octahedral d²sp³ → yes.
(vii) Cu product: [CuCl₄]²⁻ — tetrahedral sp³ → no.
(viii) Ag product: [Ag(CN)₂]⁻ — sp linear → no.
Only (iii) and (vi) are d²sp³, so the count is 2.
